decision: Can CC distinguish external adoption evidence from internal work receipts and keep every adoption-gated territory closed until the required real-world event is confirmed?
liveConsumer: The founder or release operator deciding whether first-use invitations, agent, file, covenant, science, or group gates have actually fired.

gates.evidence: The founder explicitly directed Codex to begin Phase 5 on 2026-07-15.
codex.md §M defines adoption events as actions caused by people or agents outside the project; internal builds, tests, capsules, and founder self-review cannot satisfy them.

sourceRequirements: codex.md §M1 and §M3-§M8 for adoption-event gates, locked territories, failure rules, and the five-number release readout.
docs/PREVIEW-FEEDBACK-LOOP.md, docs/R1-REVIEW.md, docs/ADOPTION-KIT.md, and docs/PATH-TO-FIRST-USERS.md for the first-five, 20-50, real-decision, and learning-receipt contracts.
C:/engine/README.md for frozen scope, exact verification, result cards, and claim boundaries.
C:/consoledia/program/PROMOTION_GATES_SPEC.md and C:/consoledia/experiments/memory/README.md for recorded-versus-promoted separation, evidence packets, negative results, and explicit authorization.

preconditions.evidence: The repository contains recruiting templates and founder feedback, but no completed external learning receipt, external citation, file-transfer proof, covenant adoption, replication interest, or organic-group event.
The existing clean research/first_use_audit.js can absorb adoption-gate validation, so Phase 5 does not create another top-level audit command.

doneWhen: A machine-readable registry names the current first-use and §M adoption gates, thresholds, accepted external event types, and unlocked territory.
An append-only JSONL ledger begins with zero adoption events and cannot count its initialization record or template as adoption.
A strict event schema requires external actor class, evidence, privacy-safe fields, claim boundary, and explicit founder/release-owner confirmation.
The existing first-use audit validates the registry and ledger, rejects internal or evidence-free events, and reports confirmed adoption events plus open and locked gate counts.
In-memory adversarial fixtures prove pending, internal, and evidence-free records do not count while a confirmed external evidence record does.
A short runbook and terminal result explain how to record future events without storing contact details or private values.
stopConditions: Any internal capsule, test pass, founder self-review, or generated artifact would count as external adoption.
The ledger would store a tester's name, email, contact details, exact private values, or sensitive decision details.
Any gate would be marked open without enough confirmed, evidence-bearing external events.
The work would edit strategy docs, app/search code, content datasets, or the inherited-dirty Phase 0 runtime implementation.
The work would add another standalone audit instead of consolidating into first_use_audit.js.
expectedArtifacts: An adoption-gate registry, event schema, append-only ledger initializer, and privacy-safe event template.
A consolidated first-use/adoption audit with adversarial fixture checks.
An operational runbook, frozen baseline, and terminal Phase 5 result card.

claimBoundary.supports: CC can record and count privacy-safe, externally caused adoption events without confusing them with internal work receipts, and can keep all current gates mechanically locked at zero.
claimBoundary.doesNotSupport: That any real adoption event has occurred, that a tester was recruited, or that any §M locked territory is authorized to open.
